item.title: Self-Hosted Usage Metering in 2026: OpenMeter vs Meteroid vs Flexprice Compared
item.description: Every API product eventually hits the same wall. You launch with a flat monthly plan, a customer asks for per-seat pricing, another wants to pay per thousand requests, and suddenly your billing logic lives in a spreadsheet, three cron jobs and a production incident report. By the time revenue depends on accurate metering, the meter is the most critical piece of infrastructure nobody planned for.
